title: Original availability by firm age and financial year, 2012-2025
question: Are young firms the absent ones, and did 2022 move all ages alike?
notes_text: Source: RFSD v3.1.0; lab aggregation of the foundation registry by financial year and age at year-end (released age, otherwise the age implied by the registry creation date; unknown ages form their own row). Tiles with fewer than 50 eligible records are gray; 2011 has no original statements and is omitted. A diagonal reads as one registration cohort ageing through the years; the eligible population changes with entry and removal, so a tile is not a fixed set of firms. The 2018 to 2019 step coincides with the provider change. Descriptive; no survival claim.
reading: Availability rises with firm age in both eras: the newest firms report least, and each registration cohort reports more as it ages, visible along the diagonals. The 2019 step applies at every age.
caveats: A tile is not a fixed set of firms
Unknown ages form their own row
source_line: Foundation registry, lab aggregation by age and year
